notes: stage 4 winding-temperature of mg90-d on dev-v006-2A-D, no capture of its own: stage 3's sittings, 521 sweeps over four days. One servo, one board. Reads: 20 ms sub-windows of streamed driven segments of the stopped-rotor sweeps through oscnb.winding.gate, R = (V_c - V0) / i_w under oscnb.speed.construct with stage 1's in-drive offset; blocks of 100 ms at read_current_floor_a or more, bridged seats (under 0.9 of R0) out. Floors: same seat = a sub-window's sd about its window's line, median and 10 to 90 %; across seats = pooled sd of the first read of repeated stop, rail and duty chains, median and range over stop-1, rails-7, meter-8. Heat: oscnb.winding.heat, joules at R0, bounds from its named constants. Estimate: oscnb.winding.run from a zero state over every piece; residual ln R - ln R(T_w), seat-referenced (group mean out, weights 0.10 % same seat, 0.70 % across seats); fit sittings 1, 6, 9, held out 2, 3, 5, 10. one_node_*: value the fit sittings, lo/hi over the fit, the swap, all and the unstreamed heat at its bounds, fold_lo/hi over the three fits, stat_factor the fit's se as a factor. two_node_slow_c: tau2 / gain2 over tau2 35 to 263 s on the fit sittings and on all, median and range; the slow gain and tau are not graded. load anchored: each load block's residual less its group's reads under 0.25 A, across seats; speed = residual x R0 i / Ke. Candidates: a_ntc the NTC alone, b_one one node, c_two two nodes. family_* and the slow share of every joined_* key: quoted from earlier work on another MG90 (mg90-a on dev-v006 rev 2A board #1, the firmware repo's notebooks 17 to 21), read from earlier-work.json beside the notebook with its provenance. None of that work's data is loaded and no grade is read against it. family_parallel_*: the earlier two-node chain's rows as parallel terms (oscnb.winding.parallel_of), the anchored row's value, the range over its rows. Candidates: d_low and e_high the fast gain fitted at the leaks a stored set runs (oscnb.winding.leak_s) beside one slow node, the can's rise or both modes; f_one_slow one node on the slow leak, a pair a servo of the family has carried that no notebook prints (the rise is the earlier 43.3 C/W over about 4.95 ohm at the nominal scale, the 115 s leak has no notebook source), 53.8 C/W at the 131.07 s leak on this pair's R0 and counts per A; g_family the earlier model's two modes alone; literal, three_terms and as_fitted_plus_modes run beside them. joined_fields: whole seconds and Q0.16 through oscnb.constants.encode, no rule registered. joined_fields_vs_one_slow_node_c: oscnb.winding.stored_rise_c, estimates; the plateau and the cooling are not graded on this pair.
